shortIntro.title: Can Your Phone Handle Wuthering Waves? Let’s Check ⚡📱
shortIntro.para1: Wuthering Waves is a high-speed open-world action RPG with cinematic combat, fluid dodges, and stunning visuals. It pushes mobile hardware much harder than typical RPGs.
shortIntro.para2: From real-time parries to smooth character switching, performance matters a lot. If your device struggles, you’ll face frame drops instead of enemies 😅🔥.

faqIntroText: Common Wuthering Waves questions — simplified for you 😎:

faqList.question: Is Wuthering Waves heavy for mobile?
faqList.answer: Yes. It’s a high-end open-world RPG, so mid-range or flagship devices are recommended for smooth gameplay.

faqList.question: Can low-end phones run Wuthering Waves?
faqList.answer: Yes, but with low settings and reduced FPS. Expect occasional lag during combat.

faqList.question: Why does Wuthering Waves lag or heat up?
faqList.answer: The game uses advanced graphics and real-time combat, which puts pressure on CPU and GPU. Lower settings and cooling help reduce lag.
